name: Gofish
headline:
Understanding intelligence through math,
exploring the world through curiosity.
intro:
A master's student in mathematics, focused on Agent RSI and Physical AI.
I like to ask how intelligence learns — and to walk into real mountains and everyday life.
heroCaption: Give my steps to the wild, and my curiosity to the world.
about: Hi, I'm Gofish. I'm currently pursuing a master's in mathematics at Southern University of Science and Technology, after studying Mathematical Foundation Science at Dalian University of Technology. Mathematics is where I begin to understand problems, and AI keeps bringing me new ones.

What fascinates me most is how agents improve themselves through experience, and how intelligence can truly enter the physical world through perception and action. I hope to find my own research direction between solid mathematical thinking and concrete experiments.
Off screen, I love traveling, badminton, cooking, and movies. To me, studying a problem seriously and cooking a meal seriously are both worth the effort.

research.title: Agent RSI
research.subtitle: Agents · Recursive self-improvement
research.description: If an agent rewrites its prompts, tool-use policy or memory, how can we tell whether it truly improves rather than memorizing the test tasks? I want to explore a verifiable loop: compare versions on unseen tasks, trace failures, and keep or roll back each change.

research.title: Physical AI
research.subtitle: Perception · Action · The real world
research.description: When camera views are incomplete and simulation differs from reality, how can a robot reliably grasp and place objects? I want to explore how geometric constraints and uncertainty estimates can guide action planning and verify the outcome.
